mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS id, o.user_id AS userId, o.ordered_at AS purchaseDate, p.name AS productName, p.price * op.quantity AS price, op.quantity AS quantity FROM orders o JOIN orders_products op ON o.id = op.order_id JOIN products p ON op.product_id = p.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC
